$comment: Listing metadata, applied by scripts/store-metadata.mjs in CI (manager/rules/SEO.md). actorId is added after the first deploy. The slug is workable-job-search because workable-jobs-search belongs to api-co (2026-11-02, SEO.md 3.3, the workday-job-search precedent).
seoTitle: Workable Jobs Scraper - Every Workable Career Page
seoDescription: Search every company hiring on Workable at once: job titles, places, remote work, job types and posting dates, newest first, with no login or API key.
defaultRunOptions$comment: TODO_DEPLOYED: measure on the deployed build, one run at a time, at 1024 and 2048 MB: the empty form {"maxJobs":100} (the 300 biggest career pages at 2 calls a second, about 150 s at most) and the example input (one download of Workable's feed, about 128 MB gzip, and a parse of about 860 MB of XML), with seconds, usageTotalUsd and run ids, and whether the feed arrived whole (the run message says 'was cut after its listings of' when it did not). Keep the cheaper size that finishes the empty form well inside 300 s. 1 GB until then: on the laptop a search peaked at 199 to 342 MB (b- runs, 2026-11-02, from a local copy of three quarters of the feed), but the parse is CPU-bound and CPU comes with memory on Apify. The run start bills once per GB above 1 GB, so a 2 GB default makes it $0.02 a run: lower the start price to $0.005 then, or keep 1 GB.

pricing.$comment: 2026-11-02. Rule: rules/SEO.md section 16. Main competitor by users for Workable's job: fantastic-jobs/career-site-job-listing-api, 1,632 u30, $0.012 a job plus $0.01 a run on FREE (BRONZE $0.012 plus $0.0001, GOLD $0.004), a 58-ATS database where workable is one filter. Anchors for the same job, every Workable company searched by keyword with no list: factpipe/ats-jobs-feed $0.003 (98 u30) and jtpalms/ats-jobs-index $0.003 plus $0.00005 (60 u30), multi-ATS indexes whose rows carry the description; made for Workable: jobo.world/workable-jobs-scraper-api $0.004 a row with the description (7 u30, its own database), shahidirfan/Workable-Job-Scraper $0.001 plus $0.005 (11 u30) and api-co/workable-jobs-search $0.00075 FREE, $0.0015 BRONZE (1 u30), both through Workable's job board search. Here 100 rows cost $0.26 with the start, 13% under the indexes' $0.30, and carry no description; job-details is 12.5% under jobo.world's $0.004 and above the indexes' $0.003, because each details row is a live call to apply.workable.com, which allows about 2 a second. The same job and job-details prices as smartrecruiters-jobs-search and deel-jobs-search. Start fee: a search by word downloads Workable's whole feed, about 128 MB gzip, whatever it finds, and Apify bills inbound traffic as external transfer at $0.20 a GB (Workday keyword runs GCfiTUzXHY4Hl27Kb and Of2PwwjAJ4c0KNKyF were billed 0.0071 and 0.0076 GB), so about $0.026 a run before compute, and about $0.031 with the adapter's compute estimate of $0.005 to $0.006 at 1 GB (TODO_DEPLOYED: the real compute and transfer of a keyword run). At $0.031 a paid run under about 16 rows costs more than the 80% it earns without a start fee; with $0.01 the line is about 12 rows, and a 100-row run's cost is about 12% of its $0.26. A start event is defined now, while the actor is new and private; adding one later needs Console and 14 days' notice, while a cut takes effect at once, so cut it to Apify's default $0.00005 if the publish phase measures a lower cost or the Console quality tab flags ACTOR_START_PRICE. The start is charged at the start of every run, also a link check, a named company and a run Workable refuses. Gentle ladder per the owner's decision of 2026-10-29; the start stays flat (SEO.md 16.7).

job.eventDescription: One saved job row: title, company, every place, work type, job type, department, posting date, job and apply links, company website. Also one checked job link that is closed or not found.

job-details.eventDescription: One saved job row with full details on: everything in a Job row plus the description, requirements and benefits as text and HTML, pay as numbers with its period when shown, the company's job code, city, region and country.

apify-actor-start.eventDescription: Charged by Apify when a run starts: once up to 1 GB of memory (the default) and once more for each extra GB. It pays for the download of Workable's whole feed, about 128 MB, that a search makes whatever it finds.
